source_origin: Original JavaScript implementation created for this packet from the standard LeetCode problem specification; uncertain premium contracts were cross-checked against LeetCode/LeetCode Wiki. normalization: Defines the standard LeetCode entry signature `function upsideDownBinaryTree(root)` as a self-contained synchronous function. No Gamma-specific wrapper or multi-parameter normalization was applied.
numeric_semantics: Returns node values unchanged and uses no numeric transformation.
mutation_contract: Mutates left and right pointers in place and reuses every input node.

input_domain: Finite binary trees satisfying the problem condition that every right node has a sibling and no children, including a null root.
